purpose: Diagnostic regression coverage: compare frozen cb61 base and remembered-camp-route against exact frozen v33 on the same 112 physical-side cells per arm. Reuse three already-completed base cells and one route cell, including the intentionally retained Band witness; this is not independent held-out confirmation.
selection_method: Outcome-blind subset from the existing 1104-cell 4db-v33 manifest: all 40 published maps and one already-present map from each of eight named map families in both gen and gen-s1: Band, Caves, Cells, City, Huge Shared, Random, mutated Big World, and mutated Expanse. No new map generation/seeds. All selected map IDs fixed in this preflight. The Band A candidate cells are reused from the just-completed seven-game batch.
note: Corrected v3 supersedes v2 only for future execution; v2 is preserved. Two completed cb61-base Gold Rush A/B cells are reused by checksum, in addition to the two Band A mechanism cells. Four reuse rows count toward the 112-per-arm matrix, yielding 109 fresh base games and 111 fresh route games. Diagnostic regression coverage, not held-out confirmation.
